title: BYD Shark 6 Dynamic Cab Chassis $57,900 Driveaway + Free Heavy-Duty Alloy Tray (Save $9,000) @ BYD
body:
Deal: BYD Shark 6 Dynamic Cab Chassis $57,900 Driveaway + Free Heavy-Duty Alloy Tray (Save $9,000) @ BYD

[LukeTyson91] Was waiting to see how the cherry goes but this might be enough to sway me.
[eddyah] Yeah do it.
Be real mate a 2.5L Diesel PHEV ute with a claimed payload of 1T?
The shark is already 2.7T with a 2L petrol engine. The Stockman is going to come in at closer to 3T so you've got a GVM over 3.5T which has all sorts of extra costs to deal with.
Unless the chassis is seriously using some thin steel I just don't see it.
Literally no-one is doing this math except Brett from Driving Enthusiast channel and he reckons it'll be around 2.8T with a 3.8T GVM
[BestTechAdvisor] It should have always been this price tbf
[Kommodore] If it had a ford logo it would be 90k with worse specs.
[BestTechAdvisor] Maybe, but I'm comparing BYD's Dynamic cab chassis to their Premium with tub. The pricing on their own lineup was inconsistent before we talk about what other brands are charging.
[tonyjzx] ranger phev is a giant pile of shit though
ALSO isnt there's the Chery Stockman coming
plus the Mahindra Homelander (that's not hybrid and supposed to be $40k)
hodl
[MrFrugalSpend] @tonyjzx: Quite ironic that someone in one comment asserts a Ford Ranger variant is a giant pile of sh!t .. and proceeds to promote a Chery and Mahindra over BYD
Each to their own, but I don't think I can ever get over the brand damage association of some of the unsafe and cringey piles of sh!t that came out of those two in the not too distant past - the 'outdated upon launch' PIK UP, the XUV-500 - Drive's lowest rated car in its release year that they termed 'flawed', the Mahindra Scorpio that scored ANCAP ZERO STARS, the Chery J1 that won a Choice Shonky, the two-star ANCAP rated Chery J11 that had to be recalled for safety concerns….etc
Now all of a sudden they punch out some promo images of some dual cabs with flash copied design concepts, pay some influencers to put out positive videos of them, promise low price points (which they should be!) and we are all supposed to think they are now legends at car manufacturing…
Granted they are driving a wedge into the value offerings, but if I had to place each brand on a sh!tometer scale its not going to be the 123 year old company with 3-400 million cars sold that were pioneers of the modern automotive industry….
[tonyjzx] @MrFrugalSpend: blah blah blah
tldr
guy livin' in the past
who gives a shit
[SoTightEcoLPI] I test drove this and the sealion 8. The shark drives very well. I decided to keep the old 7 seater run around and keep the funds parked in the offset. If it ain't broke don't replace it in this economy! Cash is king 👑
[petrichor] Nice to see someone using the phrase cash is king in its intended form
[Jbomba] Needs to be cheaper than this again. The dynamic has no ventilated seats , a smaller screen and no heads up display. Prob the worst value out of the bunch.
[plmko] What happened to just oh wow $57k for a comfortable, practical and economical ute. Smaller screen yeah nah.
[Kegsta] Pricing on this one was just silly before.
Advertised as cheaper but actually more expensive than the premium with the tray, it has a lot of features cut out.
No wonder they have heaps in stock to dump.
I just had my 1 year service for my shark premium which was $57k in July last year.
[spicygastropod] Coming to long-term, distressed-stock storage in a field near you.
[Regie69] Took the Alpha 3.0l for a drive today, pretty impressive comparing to my Alpha PHEV.
A few options missing compared to the PHEV though.
[MrZ] What does this have to do with this deal?
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] I've seen a lot of these Shark driving on the road now. the size is the limit I think, lots of them bouncing between the lines because it's so big (but not as big as US size).
I watched a video on this cheaper version. one bad comment was the location of the charging port. I forgot but checked pictures, it's behind a giant awkward shape door, and it's like further in than the rest of the car under the back storage tray, they said so awkward low spot that's difficult to see and plug and unplug. could have done a better job on the location they said.
[MrZ] It's hardly much bigger than a normal size ute. About 10cm longer and similar width.
[CalmLemons] so this was priced higher than the premium model even before?
